enabled.name: Enable automation
enabled.hint: When an ability is used, record its targets and apply its results on the Director's client.

damageMode.name: Damage
damageMode.hint: Automatic applies damage as soon as the card appears. Ask the Director and Manual list it with an Apply button. Off ignores damage.

healingMode.name: Healing and temporary Stamina
healingMode.hint: How healing and temporary Stamina from abilities are applied.

conditionsMode.name: Conditions and effects
conditionsMode.hint: How conditions and effects from abilities are applied, after the potency check.

potencyGate.name: Check potency
potencyGate.hint: Apply a condition only when the target fails (or, if the effect says so, succeeds on) the potency check against its characteristic.

potencyAlwaysMeansFailure.name: Treat 'always' with potency as 'on failure'
potencyAlwaysMeansFailure.hint: Many abilities store 'always' for effects that do have a potency. With this on, such effects apply only when the target fails the potency.

targetedConditions.name: Frightened, taunted and grabbed
targetedConditions.hint: Automatic hands these conditions to Draw Steel: Combat Tools when its conditions are on, and otherwise applies the system's own conditions with their source (grabbed follows the setting below). Our own effects always uses the system's conditions, even with Combat Tools. Off leaves them for you.
targetedConditions.auto: Combat Tools when it handles them, otherwise our own effects

autoGrab.name: Apply grabbed automatically
autoGrab.hint: Grabbing ignores size rules when applied this way and needs the Director to view the scene. Off: grabbed waits for confirmation.

lockDstdRows.name: Lock Target Damage rows
lockDstdRows.hint: Disable Target Damage's apply buttons for results Automation Suite already applied, so nothing is applied twice.

sweepOnReady.name: Unresolved cards after reload
sweepOnReady.hint: Cards posted while no Director was connected: show a Resolve now button, resolve them automatically when the Director connects, or do nothing.

sweepWindowMinutes.name: Look-back for automatic resolve (minutes)
sweepWindowMinutes.hint: Only cards younger than this are resolved automatically when the Director connects.

mixedTierSafety.name: Ask when tiers are ambiguous
mixedTierSafety.hint: If two tokens of the same creature rolled different tiers, their results wait for you instead of being applied.

hideNpcNumbersFromPlayers.name: Hide immunities from players
hideNpcNumbersFromPlayers.hint: Players see the rolled damage but not immunities, weaknesses or final damage of creatures they do not own.

playerAuthoredMode.name: Cards posted by players
playerAuthoredMode.hint: Caps automation for cards posted by players: Ask the Director or Manual keeps their results waiting even where the modes above say Automatic.

cardActionRole.name: Who may use card buttons
cardActionRole.hint: Lowest role (besides the Director) allowed to apply or undo results on Automation sections. The Director always may. The active Director's client checks every request.

playerCardActions.name: Which cards players may act on
playerCardActions.hint: Above the role, users act on cards they posted or whose creature they own; with the second option also on results whose targets they all own. They can always undo what they applied.

respectDstdApplications.name: Respect Target Damage applications
respectDstdApplications.hint: Results already applied from Draw Steel: Target Damage are marked 'applied elsewhere' and not applied again.

reactiveTests.name: Automate reactive tests
reactiveTests.hint: Abilities whose targets each make a test ("each enemy in the area makes an Intuition test"): when a target's test is rolled, its tier's damage, conditions and forced movement are applied from the ability card and can be undone there. A rerolled test replaces that target's result. The test card's own apply buttons are locked. Needs Draw Steel: Target Damage.

reviveOnHeal.name: Revive when healed
reviveOnHeal.hint: When a defeated creature (not a hero, retainer or minion) is healed above 0 Stamina, revive it: the Dead status, the defeated mark in combat and Death Tracker's skull go. A creature killed at positive Stamina (Power Word Kill) stays dead.

reviveOnUndo.name: Revive on undo
reviveOnUndo.hint: When undoing damage that defeated a creature, revive it through Draw Steel: Death Tracker (back in its squad, captain restored). Needs the Director to view the creature's scene; otherwise the row says to use Raise Dead.

autoApplyDelayMs.name: Delay before applying (ms)
autoApplyDelayMs.hint: Wait this long after a card appears before its results are applied automatically.

waitForDiceSoNice.name: Wait for Dice So Nice
waitForDiceSoNice.hint: With Dice So Nice active, apply results after the dice stop rolling on the Director's screen, or on the roller's screen while the Director's window is in the background (at most 15 seconds).

promptDialog.name: Confirmation dialog
promptDialog.hint: On this Director client: when a card has results that wait for confirmation (Ask the Director), open a dialog to apply them right away.

compactCard.name: Compact automation card
compactCard.hint: On this client: the Automation section of a card shows one line per target (name, tier, result, status, buttons); details are in the tooltips.

foldDetails.name: Fold details on automated cards
foldDetails.hint: On this client: on cards the automation resolved, Target Damage's panel (dice, edges and banes, Combat Tools rows, Update Targets) is folded under a Details button, and Combat Tools' own message for a teleport the card ran shrinks to one line.

heroSaves.name: Saving throws: player-owned creatures
heroSaves.hint: At the end of a hero's turn, each "save ends" effect needs a saving throw. Ask the player: their client opens the save dialog (if nobody answers in time, see "No answer"). Roll automatically: no dialog. Draw Steel's own: the system's handling, but at most once per effect per turn.

npcSaves.name: Saving throws: the Director's creatures
npcSaves.hint: Roll automatically: no dialog, the card shows the result. Draw Steel's own: a dialog on the Director's screen for each effect.

savePromptSeconds.name: Saving throws: seconds to answer
savePromptSeconds.hint: How long the player's save dialog stays open before the Director's client takes over.

saveFallback.name: Saving throws: no answer
saveFallback.hint: When a player does not answer in time or no owner is connected. A player who closes the dialog skips the save.
saveFallback.dialog: Open the dialog for the Director

npcSaveMessageMode.name: Saving throws: visibility of the Director's rolls
npcSaveMessageMode.hint: Who sees automatic saves of the Director's creatures.

ongoingDamage.name: Ongoing damage
ongoingDamage.hint: Effects that deal damage at the start or end of each of a creature's turns (such as Burning) post a damage card once per turn. Automatic applies it at once; the other modes leave it on the card.

ongoingFromDescription.name: Ongoing damage: read effect text
ongoingFromDescription.hint: Also recognise ongoing damage from an effect's description ("takes [[/damage 1d6 fire]] damage at the start of each of their turns"), not only from effects set up for this module.

systemFixes.name: Fix Draw Steel 1.1 turn bugs
systemFixes.hint: Save cards keep their hero-token button, and save-ends and other encounter effects are removed when a creature leaves combat or the encounter ends. Only active on system versions that have the bugs.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Write detailed Automation Suite logs to the browser console (this client only).

forcedMovementMode.name: Forced movement
forcedMovementMode.hint: Push, pull and slide results move the target. Automatic moves straight pushes and pulls at once; moves that need a choice (slides, vertical moves, "push or pull") always wait for the Director. With Draw Steel: Combat Tools its engine moves the token (walls, collisions, falls); without it only straight pushes and pulls on square grids are moved.

forcedPath.name: Forced movement path
forcedPath.hint: Straight line: pushes and pulls go straight away from or towards the ability's user without asking. Director picks: Combat Tools' path picker opens on the Director's screen for every forced movement.

forcedFallback.name: Forced movement without Combat Tools
forcedFallback.hint: Without Draw Steel: Combat Tools, move straight pushes and pulls ourselves (walls and creatures stop the target; collision damage is left to the Director). Off: forced movement rows are reminders only.

libraryEnabled.name: Ability library
libraryEnabled.hint: Use automation from library modules (such as the suite's built-in library) and detached automation on items, on top of what the system describes. Off: only the system's own power roll effects are automated.

libraryDefersToCombatTools.name: Library: leave Combat Tools' own automation alone
libraryDefersToCombatTools.hint: When an ability carries Combat Tools' automation of a kind (its heal, cleanse, teleport, damage, condition or resource buttons on the card), the library does not add rows of that kind.

resourceMode.name: Resources
resourceMode.hint: Surges, heroic resource and Recoveries that library abilities grant.

triggersEnabled.name: Triggered actions
triggersEnabled.hint: When a triggered action from the automation library could react (Parry, Inertial Shield, Word of Guidance ...), ask the creature's owner first and hold the damage, roll or turn until they answer.

triggerPromptSeconds.name: Triggered action prompt (seconds)
triggerPromptSeconds.hint: How long the owner has to answer. Without an answer the event goes ahead unchanged. Damage from other buttons waits at most 10 seconds.

triggerFallback.name: Owner not connected
triggerFallback.hint: Who answers for a hero whose players are all offline.
triggerFallback.skip: Nobody: the triggered action is not used

triggersOutsideCombat.name: Triggered actions outside combat
triggersOutsideCombat.hint: Also offer triggered actions when no combat has started (there is no per-round limit then).

triggerNpcs.name: Director's creatures react
triggerNpcs.hint: Ask the Director when a creature without a player owner could use a triggered action from the library (for example the Arixx's Skitter).

triggerExternalDamage.name: Hold damage from other buttons
triggerExternalDamage.hint: Also hold damage applied by the system's Apply Damage button, Target Damage rows and Combat Tools (a prompt of at most 10 seconds, so Target Damage does not time out). Minion squads, collision and fall damage and Stamina loss are never held.

triggerTrackers.name: Judgement and Mark trackers
triggerTrackers.hint: When a creature judged or marked through the library drops to 0 Stamina, ask its censor or tactician to use the ability on a new target; using it again ends the older effect.

triggerRollLock.name: Hold rolls for triggered actions
triggerRollLock.hint: Lock the roll dialog of a damage-dealing ability while an ally may add an edge to it (Word of Guidance).

deferToTriggersModule.name: Leave triggers to Draw Steel: Triggers
deferToTriggersModule.hint: When the Draw Steel: Triggers module is active, these triggered actions, holds and trackers stay off.

summonMode.name: Summons
summonMode.hint: How summon rows are applied. They are always placed on the canvas, so Automatic acts as Ask.

summonPlacement.name: Director's summon placement
summonPlacement.hint: Pick the squares on your canvas, or let the Director's client choose the nearest free squares. Players always pick.

summonTurnChain.name: Summons act after their summoner
summonTurnChain.hint: In the default initiative mode, a summon that acts after its summoner waits (it cannot be activated earlier) and takes its turn as soon as the summoner's turn ends.

summonSquadLabels.name: Label summon squads
summonSquadLabels.hint: Name new summon squads Group N and apply Combat Tools' squad labels when they are on.

summonEncounterEnd.name: Summons at the end of the encounter
summonEncounterEnd.hint: What is removed when a combat is deleted.

summonOwnerPotency.name: Summoner potency link
summonOwnerPotency.hint: Mark hero summons with their summoner (flags.world.ownerUuid) for the Summoner class module's potency.

summonUpkeepSeconds.name: Persistent upkeep prompt (seconds)
summonUpkeepSeconds.hint: Persistent upkeep prompts (summons, areas and Persistent abilities): how long the owner has to keep it.

persistentUpkeep.name: Persistent abilities
persistentUpkeep.hint: At the user's turn start, ask their player to keep a Persistent ability use for its cost: the free roll again, effects that last until the next decision. Off: Persistent stays a reminder.

resourceGains.name: Resource gains
resourceGains.hint: First-time-each-round gains of heroic resources (Ferocity when hit, Focus on a marked foe…) as undoable rows. Ask the Director: the rows wait for a click.

heroTokenPrompt.name: Hero tokens on a lethal hit
heroTokenPrompt.hint: Offer a hero's player (the Director for a hero without one) to spend 2 hero tokens and regain the hero's recovery value when our damage would drop the hero to 0 Stamina or less.

maliceReminders.name: Malice reminders
maliceReminders.hint: At a monster's turn start, whisper the Director the malice features the pool can pay, with Use buttons.

villainActionTracking.name: Villain action tracking
villainActionTracking.hint: Mark villain actions used this encounter and warn on a second use or a second villain action in a round.

zoneMode.name: Areas
zoneMode.hint: Lasting areas from the library (Wall of Fire…). Automatic: an area drawn when the ability is used, or one built around its creator, is applied when the card resolves; any other area waits for Place, as with Ask.

zoneDamage.name: Area damage
zoneDamage.hint: How damage from lasting areas is applied. Off: areas deal no damage.

modeByActorType.name: Results by creature type
modeByActorType.hint: Overrides the modes above for the creature a result lands on: heroes, retainers, NPCs, minions, summons and objects. Same as above keeps the feature's mode; Off stays a feature setting. The author's cap above still applies.

summonInterceptNative.name: Place the system's summons
summonInterceptNative.hint: When an ability uses Draw Steel's own summoning (system 1.2 and later), its creatures are placed by the summoner's player and join combat, squads and dismissal like the library's summons. Off leaves the system's own placement.

frightenedMoveWarning.name: Warn when frightened creatures move closer
frightenedMoveWarning.hint: A creature frightened by our own effect warns its mover when a move brings it closer to the source. The move is never blocked.

automaticAreas.name: Prepare area targets automatically
automaticAreas.hint: Center bursts and auras on their user; place aimed areas once and select valid targets before the roll.

gainUndoKeepsSlot.name: Undone gains keep their slot
gainUndoKeepsSlot.hint: When a once-per-round or once-per-encounter resource gain (Focus on a marked foe, Ferocity when hit, ...) is undone, it still counts as taken for that round or encounter, so the next matching event does not grant it again. Off: Undo frees the slot (the default). The resource API can still release a slot by hand.

heroTokenRerollPowerRolls.name: Hero tokens reroll power rolls
heroTokenRerollPowerRolls.hint: House rule. Ability cards of heroes get a button to spend 1 hero token and reroll the power roll, as Draw Steel allows for tests. Applied rows are undone first, then the card resolves again with the new tiers. Off by default.

medkitRole.name: Smart Automation: who may open it
medkitRole.hint: Users at or above this role see the Automation windows and badges' click. Changing an item's automation also needs ownership of the item.

showBadge.name: Smart Automation: status badge on ability sheets
showBadge.hint: Show how stef-ds-automation automates an ability as a small badge in the sheet's title bar.

locked.label: Locked
locked.hint: Its automation is frozen: no detach, re-sync or reset until unlocked.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.hint: Automation off for this item: its rows wait for a click and library effects are ignored.

outdated.label: Outdated
outdated.hint: Detached from an older version of the library overlay: re-sync to take the new one.

customized.label: Customized
customized.hint: Uses automation entries stored on the item (detached or authored by hand).

unavailable.label: Unavailable
unavailable.hint: The library overlay needs a module that is not active.

covered.label: Combat Tools
covered.hint: Combat Tools automates everything the library would add to this ability.

configurable.label: Configurable
configurable.hint: Automated by the library, with options you can set.

automated.label: Automated
automated.hint: The library adds automation beyond the system's own effects.

native.label: Native
native.hint: Only the system's own power roll effects are automated.

manual.label: Manual
manual.hint: Nothing about this ability is automated.

Actor.Title: Automation: {name}

Actor.NoneSelected: Select one or more abilities first.

Hint.disable: Turn this ability's automation off (rows wait for a click).
Hint.lock: Freeze the automation as it is.
Hint.detach: Copy the library automation onto the item as editable entries (special effects). They survive Combat Tools' refresh and Update Source.
Hint.resync: Replace the entries with the current library version (options and lock are kept).
Hint.reset: Remove the entries: the item follows the library again.

Confirm.resync: Replace this item's automation entries with the current library version? Edits made to the entries are lost.
Confirm.reset: Remove this item's automation entries? Edits made to them are lost and the item follows the library again.

Effect.recoveries: Spend {count} Recovery and heal its value

Coverage.Title: Automation coverage
Coverage.Hint: How many abilities of each compendium the library or the system automates.
Coverage.Intro: Abilities per compendium: automated by the library, by the system's own effects only, or not at all. Nothing is written to the compendiums.

Trigger.Heading: Triggers
Trigger.EndsOnDying: ends when its source is dying
Trigger.BudgetUntracked: Triggered action: not tracked (no combat, or triggered actions off)

Maintenance.coverageHint: Per ability compendium, how many abilities the library, the system, or nothing automates (the Smart Automation coverage report).
Maintenance.customizedHint: Items whose automation is stored on the item (detached or edited, also outdated ones): a library update does not reach them, and the suite's cleanup can remove them.
Maintenance.customizedNone: No item in this world has customized automation.

Editor.Title: Automation editor
Editor.Hint: Choose when a rule runs, who it affects, and what it does. Changes are saved only with Save automation.
Editor.Suppress: Native effects replaced by these rules
Editor.ReplaceHint: Replace the current draft with this preset? Changes are saved only when you press Save.
Editor.ClearHint: Remove the custom rules and return to the item’s library automation?
Editor.Subject: Whose event triggers this rule?
Editor.ActivateOnUse: Also apply when this ability is used (its native use pays its cost)
Editor.NoEffects: Add an effect to specify damage, movement, conditions, or another result.
Editor.NoRules: No custom rules yet. Add a rule or load a preset to get started.
Editor.FormulaHint: Use a number or a formula, such as @M + 2.
Editor.OverrideHint: Rule recipients uses the Who section. Acting creature applies only to the creature using this feature.
Editor.SuppressHint: Checked native effects are replaced by your rules. Add a matching effect below to keep that behavior.
Editor.DurationHint: Default keeps the normal duration for each effect. Instant damage and movement do not persist.
Editor.FormulaGuide: Formulas use the acting creature’s roll data. Separate list values with commas.
Editor.PresetHint: Loading a preset changes this draft. Save automation applies it to the item. Saved presets are independent copies.
